prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent-background sheet of FOUR distinct adult character bust portraits for the satirical road-trip game The Portland Trail. Input Image 1 is only a style reference: use its warm, eccentric pixel-art people, green handheld-game tones and thick dark contours. Create new original characters.
A spacious balanced two-by-two layout, isolated portraits with true alpha between them. Identical chest-up crop, head scale, straight-on camera, eye line, lighting and consistent pixel geometry. Exaggeration is affectionate and dry, each character readable and expressive:
Top left: SOCIAL MEDIA INFLUENCER archetype, self-confident adult woman with a neat bob and oversized glasses, holding a phone near one shoulder; tiny ring-light prop at the other shoulder.
Top right: GIG ECONOMY DEVELOPER archetype, tired adult man with messy hair, hoodie, under-eye fatigue and skeptical expression, small laptop edge and takeaway coffee visible at chest level.
Bottom left: PORTLAND DOOMSDAY PREPPER archetype, practical middle-aged adult woman in a knit cap and utility vest, suspicious raised eyebrow, a compact roll of gear and sprouting plant in one vest pocket.
Bottom right: ARTISANAL BARISTA archetype, adult man with a short mustache, rolled sleeves and apron, wry knowing smile, holding a small pour-over dripper and coffee server at chest level.
Palette tightly controlled to green shades #07110A, #18331B, #426E35, #A4C96A. Crisp stepped pixel edges, simple expressive eyes, coherent heavy outlines, minimal restrained dither. Readable at 64x64 per portrait. No lettering, labels, numerals, logos, panel frames, scenery, backdrop color, glow, watermarks or checkerboard pattern. Do not add additional faces or full bodies. High-resolution concept sheet; actual transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated high-resolution van design master for The Portland Trail game, on a genuinely transparent background. Image 1 is the reference for the van's personality, green palette, boxy vintage body, square windows, robust dark contours and comically overloaded roof rack. Translate that van into an EXACT clean side-profile view facing RIGHT, without perspective foreshortening.
One compact battered eco-van fills a wide landscape frame with generous transparent margins. Short hood on the right, large squared passenger body, two visible wheels on a single ground baseline, simple wheel hubs, readable side door seams and rectangular windows. Weathered dents and a couple of tiny blank stickers give character. Roof rack holds an unmistakable coherent arrangement: large rectangular suitcase at the rear/left, rolled sleeping mat in the middle, smaller case and tied duffel at the front/right, all secured by two visible straps. These luggage positions should be easy to preserve in later animation. No people, no exterior props detached from the vehicle. Neutral parked state, hood closed, wheels stationary, no smoke or confetti.
Disciplined chunky retro pixel-art aesthetic, crisp stepped silhouettes, consistent dark outline, limited greens near-black #07110A, dark #18331B, middle #426E35, highlight #A4C96A, restrained dither and top-left highlights. Prioritize readability at an eventual 128x64 sprite cell. No text, labels, logos, titles, ground plane, scenery, baked shadow, UI frame, glow, watermark, or fake transparency checkerboard. Actual alpha transparency. This is a single vehicle master for later animation, not a multi-frame sheet.
